title: Remove UI legacy fallback for remotes omitting queueProjectionHash (513018d)
outcome: Post-audit regression introduced by commit 513018d (2026-09-22): ui/src/app-live-state-transport-events.ts:331-338 — 'Older remotes that omit the hash keep the bounded legacy fallback'. This is cross-version wire acceptance between TermAl builds, which tm-7p9z.5 ('one current TermAl-to-TermAl remote protocol') was supposed to eliminate: mismatched remotes are unsupported until upgraded via POST /api/remotes/{id}/upgrade. Remove the fallback; an older remote omitting queueProjectionHash should be a protocol break, not a heuristic fallback. Found in Kimi's no-legacy re-audit 2026-09-25 (session-7706).
acceptance: The legacy fallback branch is removed; snapshots from remotes missing queueProjectionHash follow the normal protocol-error/resync path; cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit clean and npx vitest run green.
